context.title: Activate-Technology-and-Media-Outlook-2024
context.overview: ACTIVATE TECHNOLOGY & MEDIA OUTLOOK 2024 by Activate covers consumer behavior, creator ecosystems, major technology trends, generative AI, eCommerce, gaming, the metaverse, spatial computing, and media revenues.
key_findings: Hybrid work challenges are driving sustained IT and software spend; security, privacy, and collaboration tools are top planned investments.

candidate.why_fit: The report is titled and framed as a Technology & Media Outlook and repeatedly analyzes core technology trends and infrastructure.

context.title: Activate-2025-Social-Video
context.overview: ACTIVATE CONSULTING TECHNOLOGY & MEDIA OUTLOOK 2025 — SOCIAL VIDEO is focused on the social video market: platform user demographics, advertising revenue trends, creator engagement rankings, and social video platforms.
key_findings: A diverse group of creators drives the majority of social video engagement, with limited overlap across platforms.
Top creators concentrate very large view and engagement counts across YouTube, TikTok, Instagram, and Facebook.

candidate.why_fit: The report is explicitly centered on social video platforms, creator ecosystems, short-form engagement and creator rankings.
evidence_sections: Forecast — Average daily social video time spent

context.title: influencer-portfolio-ebook-0426
context.overview: A practical guide to influencer marketing that explains creator tiers, portfolio construction, platform deployment, compensation, measurement frameworks, and scaling a creator program.
key_findings: A diversified influencer portfolio is necessary to cover the full funnel.
Modern compensation and clear briefs improve creator experience and recruitment.

candidate.why_fit: The report repeatedly centers creators, creator tiers, creator economics, and platform deployment.
candidate.why_not_fit: Not focused on in-app commerce mechanics.

context.title: influencer-portfolio-ebook-0426
context.overview: A practical guide to influencer marketing that explains creator tiers, portfolio construction, platform deployment, compensation, measurement frameworks, and scaling a creator program.
key_findings: Measurement infrastructure connects creator activity to revenue.
Repurposing creator content supports multi-touch journeys.

candidate.why_fit: The report links creators to revenue and discusses repurposing creator content across platforms to drive purchases.
candidate.why_not_fit: The report is not about in-platform checkout, live shopping, or TikTok Shop mechanics.
evidence_sections: Chapter 6: Measuring your influencer portfolio performance

context.title: Activate Consumer Internet and Media Trends
context.overview: Slide report presenting consumer internet and media forecasts across revenue, smart speakers, reality computing, web video, premium video, ecommerce, and podcasts.
key_findings: Web video views are highly concentrated: a relatively small subset of creators capture the majority of views, and influencers and media companies dominate top-view shares on YouTube and Facebook.

candidate.why_fit: The report calls out creator dynamics, top creators, and influencer reach in web video.
candidate.why_not_fit: Creator coverage exists within a broader media and revenue forecast context.

context.title: Consumer Media Outlook
context.overview: Technology is only an enabling theme inside a broader consumer media report.
key_findings: Audience behavior, media spend, and consumer demand dominate.

context.title: Activate-2025-Social-Video
